name: Hotels & Resorts
seo: Where to sleep on Cebu, from air-conditioned city hotels a walk from Ayala and Fuente Osmeña to dive resorts on Panagsama Beach and family beach resorts on Mactan. Serviced apartments and condo stays suit anyone staying a month or longer; hostels cover the backpacker route south. Each listing shows the district, the price band and how close it sits to the airport, the pier or the reef.

subSeo.Hotels: City hotels from budget to business class, mostly around Fuente Osmeña, Mango Avenue and Cebu Business Park.
subSeo.Beach Resorts: Beachfront resorts on Mactan, Moalboal and the south coast — day passes as well as overnight stays.
subSeo.Dive Resorts: Resorts built around the reef: on-site dive shop, gear rental and boats leaving from the beach.
subSeo.Hostels: Dorms and guesthouses on the backpacker route, with fan and air-conditioned rooms.
subSeo.Serviced Apartments: Condos and apartments by the week or month — kitchen, laundry and wifi for long stays.

items.name: Astillo`s Guest Houses
items.address: libaong, Moalboal, 6032 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Astillo’s Guest Houses offers a remarkably warm, peaceful, and home-like atmosphere with beautifully maintained grounds. Guests consistently praise the exceptional cleanliness, delicious breakfasts, and the incredibly kind hosts who provide genuine hospitality. For convenience, visitors can rent scooters directly on-site, use the laundry service, or ask the owners to arrange local transport and bus station transfers.

items.name: The SHUIM Dive Resort 더쉼 다이브 리조트 모알보알
items.address: Philippines, Cebu, Moalboal, Basdiot, Tuble
items.desc: Located away from the noisy town center, The SHUIM Dive Resort offers a cozy, meticulously maintained beachfront atmosphere with exceptionally warm hospitality from its Korean owners. Highlights include delicious daily Korean meals, comfortable rooms with practical amenities like swimwear drying racks, and top-tier dive instruction with direct reef access to spot turtles and whale sharks. Guests can relax at the private beach or treehouse, interact with friendly resident pets, and easily organize bike rental delivery straight to the resort.

items.name: BANANA BEACH CLUB
items.address: X959+GP7, Tuble Rd, Moalboal, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Banana Beach Club is a fresh, brand-new resort offering a relaxing island vibe with exceptionally clean rooms and warm, 24/7 attentive staff. Highlights include a pristine pool, beachfront snorkeling with free equipment, beach volleyball, and stunning sunset views. For practical tips, take advantage of their free tricycle transfers to nearby Panagsama Beach, though consider comparing prices locally if you plan to book external tours.

items.name: Moalboal Cay Hostel
items.address: brgy, Panagsama Rd, Basdiot, Moalboal, 6032 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Moalboal Cay Hostel offers a quiet, welcoming sanctuary on a peaceful dead-end road just a two-minute walk from town, dive shops, and the beach. Guests adore the spotless, spacious apartment-style rooms with impressive noise cancellation, as well as the delicious complimentary breakfast, fantastic coffee, and friendly resident dogs. Helpful staff and affordable on-site scooter rentals make exploring Moalboal effortless, making this the ultimate spot for a relaxing stay.

items.name: Eskapo Verde Lodge Moalboal
items.address: Santander - Barili - Toledo Rd, Bugas, Badian, 6031 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Eskapo Verde Lodge is a serene, eco-friendly sanctuary nestled in a lush mangrove forest with direct ocean access, far from the hustle of Moalboal. Guests consistently praise the pristine wooden cottages, incredibly welcoming staff, and an outstanding restaurant offering fresh meals with great vegetarian options. Note that the property is about a 15-minute ride from the town center, so renting a scooter or taking a local tricycle is recommended for getting around.
